why: Budget swaps, reopened on V24 (pilot, 2026-11-10: Bayou and Survival of the Fittest too expensive): Fabled Passage for Bayou, Exotic Orchard for Darkbore Pathway, Fauna Shaman for Survival of the Fittest

summary.title: Meren on a budget: cheaper lands and a cheaper creature tutor
summary.blurb: Swaps the two priciest lands and Survival of the Fittest for cheaper cards that do the same job: a fetch, a land that taps for any colour, and Fauna Shaman as the creature tutor.
